name: Adversarial Evasion
description: Inputs perturbed just enough to change a model's decision — bypassing a classifier, filter or detector while remaining valid to a human observer.
differs: Catalog entry R027 (Adversarial token perturbation) is the observable indicator; this is the technique. Plain-language instructions addressed to the analysing model are AI Analysis Evasion (T9.004).
